name: attendance-register
title: Attendance register
description: A register of who came: people down the side, sessions across, a present, late, absent or excused mark per cell and a rate per person.
docs: Pass people, sessions ({ id, date, title }) and marks as marks[personId][sessionId] = "late", with onMarkChange(changes, marks) to keep them. Every mark is a glyph and a word, and each cell is named in full (Mara Visser, 12 Oct, late). A cell opens a menu of present, late, absent and excused; with the keyboard the arrow keys move across the grid, P, L, A and E set a mark and Backspace clears it. Each row ends with a rate (the sessions someone came to, of those that count: excused and unmarked ones are left out), the footer counts who came, and a button in a session's heading marks everyone who has no mark yet as present. A cell that still needs a mark shows a dashed outline and a plus, so what is left to mark is seen without pointing. A session after today is disabled and says why (pass now for stable output). readOnly shows plain marks. labels translates every word.
